row_count_asserted_against: CDS ReadMe J/A+A/500/947/ReadMe -> table9.dat=395 (A2744) + table10.dat=809 (A2537); VizieR merges both into 'catalog' (1204 rows) with cluster column A records
extraction: VizieR ASU TSV export, -out=**&-out.max=unlimited. Cleaned file maps upstream columns to a standard schema (id,ra_deg,dec_deg,z,z_err,q_flag,member_flag) and appends sep_arcmin and R_proj_Mpc computed from the cluster centre with FlatLambdaCDM(H0=70,Om0=0.3). No rows dropped. Where the upstream redshift is stored as a velocity cz in km/s it is converted to z=cz/c and its uncertainty is converted consistently to dz=e_cz/c; otherwise no values are altered. Raw upstream response kept verbatim in raw/. Rows filtered to this cluster only using the upstream cluster-identifier column.
note: Abell 2744 (z=0.308). Braglia, Pierini, Biviano & Boehringer 2009, A&A 500, 947 ('Spectroscopy and photometry in A2744 and A2537'). TRAP HANDLED: the VizieR table 'catalog' merges the paper's table 9 (A2744, 395 rows) and table 10 (A2537, 809 rows) into a single 1204-row table distinguished only by the column A (Abell number). This file has been filtered to A=2744, giving exactly 395 rows, matching the ReadMe record count for table9.dat. Taking the unfiltered table would have contaminated A2744 with a completely different cluster ~530 Mpc away on the sky. Instrument: VLT/VIMOS multi-object spectroscopy. No redshift quality flag is published in this table. Selection function: photometric preselection in B,V,R from WFI imaging; the table carries W0([OII]), D4000 and W0(Hdelta) spectral indices, indicating an emission/absorption-line study. Sky coverage for the A2744 subset is given in this manifest's coverage block.
